### Leader in Deloitte’s Fashion & Luxury practice, Harris drives retail innovation with 15+ years' expertise in strategy, design, merchandising, and tech.

Harris is an experienced retail leader with deep expertise in innovation, design, and product creation for Footwear & Apparel. He boasts over a decade of retail industry and management consulting experience to help clients create a vision, define strategic plans, enable new capabilities, develop roadmaps, and design solutions to prepare for and adopt next-gen technologies and go-to-market strategies.
